description: Hard retrieval benchmark for RAG v2 / v2.1. Prefer expectedChunkIds / expectedEvidence for Evidence Recall@4; expectedSourceTitles kept for compatibility. Cases carry split=dev|test (docs/rag-v2.1-plan.md).

corpusSnapshot.note: Titles match source markdown stems / citation titles used by Hybrid retrieval.

categoryNotes.exact_identifier: Query includes a literal error code or identifier present in sources.
categoryNotes.similar_identifier: Near-miss codes or adjacent identifiers that must not collapse.
categoryNotes.hard_negative: Topically similar wrong document must not win Hit@1.
categoryNotes.no_answer: Topic absent from corpus; predicted no-answer = empty retrieval, never vacuous empty relevant lists.
categoryNotes.acl_deny: Documents the deny contract; current open corpus may have zero restricted docs.
